gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Verifies that {@code now()} reports the same day-of-month as the system clock. Retried because the value can change at midnight while the test runs.
ADDED i3: Verifies that {@code now(ZoneId)} reports the same day-of-month as the clock in that zone. Retried because the value can change at midnight while the test runs.
ADDED i4: Day 28 is valid in every month (it never exceeds any month's length, not even February), so {@code atMonth} should keep the day unchanged for all twelve months.
